workLog.action: #3625: remove two merge drivers that never took effect.
workLog.result: Git resolves a merge attribute through git config merge.<name>.driver, which is per clone and never committed. No script registered handoff-aggregate or ours, so both lookups failed and git fell back to the default text merge. The ours entry was doubly wrong: ours is a strategy and a strategy option, not a low-level driver name. Replaced 119 lines of documentation promising conflict resolution that did not exist with a 24-line accurate explanation. ADR-014 still enforces HANDOFF.md read-only via the pre-commit hook.

workLog.action: #3597: ignore model-sweep output that lands in the tracked evals tree.
workLog.result: eval-model-sweep.py roots artifacts at REPO_ROOT, so every run writes into evals/, which holds 365 tracked files. Scoped the ignore to the sweep- run-id prefix that make_run_id guarantees, so tracked fixtures and non-sweep reports stay visible. Verified all three output shapes are ignored and that zero tracked files change status.

workLog.action: #3651: drop the stale agent count PR #2187 left behind.
workLog.result: The manifest still claimed '25 specialized agent definitions', contradicting the marketplace entry #2187 had already made count-free. Removed the number rather than correcting it, completing the earlier decision instead of reversing it.

workLog.action: #3627: flush stdout so a gate reason reaches its own error.
workLog.result: Under lefthook's pipe Python block-buffers stdout while stderr stays unbuffered, so a gate's error flushed before its reason and the reason landed under the next hook's group header, reading as that hook's output. An operator saw a commit count and limit with the explanatory line attributed elsewhere, which invites a squash that does not help. Fixed inside the shared _print_process_output helper so every gate gains the ordering rather than one call site.

workLog.action: #3616: give every optimize-artifact flag help text.
workLog.result: Introspecting the built parser found 30 of 40 subcommand flags with no help string, not the 5 the report estimated; 14 of those are required, so an operator could neither run the command nor learn what to pass. buffer-add --reason was the sharp case: required, and --help said only that it was required. Added a test that walks the parser and refuses any flag without help, so the next one cannot ship undiscoverable.

patterns.pattern: Introspect the artifact instead of trusting the report's count.
patterns.context: Issue #3616 estimated 5 flags missing help text. Walking the built argparse parser found 30.
patterns.application: When an issue quantifies a defect, re-derive the number from the artifact before scoping the fix; then leave the introspection behind as a regression fence.

patterns.pattern: Fix shared output helpers, not the reporting call site.
patterns.context: #3627 surfaced on one gate, but the interleaving came from the helper every gate uses.
patterns.application: When an ordering or formatting defect reproduces through a shared helper, fix the helper so sibling call sites inherit the fix instead of waiting for their own bug report.

patterns.pattern: Negative-control the scanner before believing a zero.
patterns.context: A blast-radius scan reported zero pwsh workflow steps. _yaml_run_scripts returns (shell, body, node) tuples, so getattr(step, 'shell') silently returned None for all 403 steps.
patterns.application: Before acting on a zero-hit scan, feed the scanner a synthetic input that must hit. A scan that cannot produce a positive proves nothing.

avoidances.antipattern: Documenting a git merge driver without registering it.
avoidances.consequence: .gitattributes advertised 'main always wins' on the file most likely to conflict while producing an ordinary conflict, the opposite of the stated intent.
avoidances.correction: A merge attribute needs a matching git config merge.<name>.driver in every clone. Without an installer that registers it, delete the attribute rather than document it.

avoidances.antipattern: Batching several commits behind one shell helper function.
avoidances.consequence: A stale index from an earlier checkout leaked unrelated files into the first commit, and the final invocation silently printed status instead of committing.
avoidances.correction: Reset the index before each commit, pass explicit pathspecs to both git add and git commit, and verify with git show --stat per commit.
